name: Vsp Ast - Ganda Tour @ M.Ou.Co, Porto
description: Vsp Ast presents the "Ganda Tour" at Mouco - Porto. The artist will perform new, unreleased, and familiar songs.
longDescription:
Vsp Ast brings the "Ganda Tour" to Mouco - Porto on Saturday, December 19, 2026. The performance starts at 9:00 PM and runs until midnight.

The artist plans to sing a mix of new material, songs never performed before, and established favorites. Tickets are available through Shotgun, with prices ranging from €10.00 for Early Birds to €15.00 for Last Chance tickets.

The venue, Mouco - Porto, is located at Rua de Frei Heitor Pinto 67, 4300-252 Porto, Portugal. Attendees can resell their tickets on the Shotgun app if their plans change.

O artista planeia cantar uma mistura de material novo, músicas nunca antes tocadas e favoritos já estabelecidos. Os bilhetes estão disponíveis através da Shotgun, com preços que variam entre os 10,00€ para os Early Birds e os 15,00€ para os bilhetes Last Chance.

A sala, Mouco - Porto, fica na Rua de Frei Heitor Pinto 67, 4300-252 Porto, Portugal. Quem mudar de planos pode revender os bilhetes na aplicação Shotgun.
